description: A light aircraft ("avioneta") standing in the forest on the walking trail at Parque Natural Altamira above Antigua; presented as a photo attraction and mapped in OSM as a named tourist attraction; "La avioneta". No source consulted names the manufacturer; model; variant or registration; and no source explains how the airframe was brought up the mountain or what its prior identity was; guatemala.com calls it simply an abandoned aircraft placed in the woods. manufacturer; model; variant; tail_number; model_name; military_civilian; role_type and year_built are all deliberately blank. wing_type recorded as monoplane by inference — every light aircraft type flown in Guatemala in the last half-century is a monoplane — and flagged as an inference rather than a sourced fact. A single visitor photograph showing the cowling; tail or a registration would identify this airframe outright.
